description: Income, expenses, and net for one calendar month across connected accounts, with the top 5 income sources and top 5 expense categories. Pending transactions are left out. Income is money coming in (negative transaction amounts); expenses are money going out (positive amounts). The response includes a `warnings` array of notices about banks that could not contribute (for example, a bank that needs reconnecting), each with a message and, when relevant, a reconnect_url.

account_id.description: Limit results to a specific account. Use an account id returned by list_accounts.

month.description: The month to report, in YYYY-MM format, for example 2026-03.

name: get_monthly_cashflow
title: Monthly Cashflow
